title: Key Material Mediator Terraform module for VPC secret routing and HSM pairing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Terraform module that acts as a mediator between cloud KMS, customer HSMs, and secret backends (AWS Secrets Manager and HashiCorp Vault) for Redwood Private VPC deployments. The module should provision the minimal networking and IAM primitives, create KMS aliases and HSM connection metadata, and wire up a managed secret object that can be reconciled to both Secrets Manager and Vault. It will include a configurable reconciliation lambda/agent (optional) for environments that cannot allow long-lived API credentials. Scope includes Terraform module code, unit tests, example usage for AWS and GCP, upgrade strategy for existing customers, and health-check hooks that expose reconciliation status to the Console. Non-goals: implementing a new KMS provider plugin or replacing customer HSM firmware. This is focused on orchestration and secrets plumbing in Terraform + small reconciliation agent where needed.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published under modules/key-material-mediator with registry-safe inputs
Module can register an HSM endpoint and create a corresponding KMS alias or key reference without storing raw key material in state
Integration examples with AWS Secrets Manager and Vault using the module are documented and tested
Reconciliation agent (optional) can be deployed as ephemeral job and reports status to Console metrics and logs
Upgrade path documented: existing terraform state can be imported and rotated with zero downtime for live tokens
Health-check endpoint and Grafana dashboard panels ingest reconciliation metrics and alert on drift or failed rotates
tasks: Design module interface and inputs (tenant_id, vpc_id, kms_provider, hsm_connection, secrets_backend)
Implement Terraform resources and null_resource hooks to avoid key material in state
Create optional lightweight reconciliation agent (Go) for air-gapped customers
Wire health-checks: reconciliation status metric, Prometheus exporter, and Console dashboard config
Write integration tests: terraform plan/apply in mocked AWS/GCP + Vault acceptance
Author docs and example recipes for rotating keys and emergency rollback
Create GH PR, get reviews from security and runtime teams, merge and publish module

qa_plan: Run terraform apply in isolated test VPC with mocked HSM endpoint and verify no PEM blobs in state files

notes: Trade-offs: null_resource + external data avoids state leakage but makes drift detection harder; compensated by reconciliation agent metrics
Canary strategy: roll module to internal infra first (non-customer), then opt-in customers, then full rollout
Design decisions logged in Confluence page; encryption keys are always referenced by alias or asymmetric public material only
